an4.178:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.178:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:1.5: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati, nappasīdati, na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
an4.178:1.6: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:1.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso lasagatena hatthena sākhaṃ gaṇheyya, tassa so hattho sajjeyyāpi gaṇheyyāpi khajjeyyāpi.
an4.178:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:1.10: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
an4.178:1.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:2.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati,
an4.178:2.3: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
an4.178:2.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:2.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso suddhena hatthena sākhaṃ gaṇheyya, tassa so hattho neva sajjeyya na gaṇheyya na bajjheyya.
an4.178:2.6: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:2.8: tassa sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
an4.178:2.9: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:3.3: tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasikaroto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ na pakkhandati na ppasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
an4.178:3.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:3.6: tassā puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, devo ca sammādhāraṃ nānuppaveccheyya. evaṃ
an4.178:3.7: hi tassā bhikkhave jambāliyā na pālippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:3.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:3.10: tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
an4.178:3.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno na avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:4.3: tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
an4.178:4.4: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:4.6: tassā puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, devo ca sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.
an4.178:4.7: evaṃ hi tassā bhikkhave jambāliyā pālippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:4.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.178:4.10: tassa avijjāppabhedaṃ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
an4.178:4.11: tassa kho etaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
an4.178:4.12: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
